profile.headline: Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin
profile.summary: Hello! My name is Ricardo, but I go by Ricky! I am a graduate from the University of Central Florida, and am wrapping up my Master's Degree in Data Analytics at Southern New Hampshire University. I am now employed as a Software Engineer at Lockheed Martin. Working here feels like a dream come true; I am over the moon at earning such an opportunity, and look forward to growing with the company!

positions.title: Software Engineer Lvl 2
positions.locationName: Cape Canaveral, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Driver development, hardware/software integration, test framework development. Code creation in C++

positions.title: Seasonal Sales Associate
positions.description: Provide quality customer service in a fast-paced, 24-hour location. Become familiar with clientele, maintain up-to-date knowledge of current trends and popular products. Handle money, work a cash register and ensure that the location is always presentable.

positions.title: Brand Representative
positions.description: Ensure the customer has a quality visit, assisting with clothing selection and purchase. Modeling brand clothing and increasing sales; working as a team to meet daily and weekly sales quotas.

positions.title: Customer Service Advisor
positions.description: Tasked with taking orders both over the phone and face-to-face, cleaning and maintenance of interior and exterior of restaurant, making food, settling disputes with customers, working as a team to accomplish certain tasks (handling a large food order, closing the store, etc.).

volunteerExperiences.description: Ran a pharmacy at pop up clinics, received experience in checking of vitals, gave oral presentation on administering CPR on those in need in the Dominican Republic.
Use knowledge of the area to explain to visitors how to get to certain locations, where the locals enjoy spending time, etc.

projects.title: Github Past Assignments
projects.description: Past assignments I have completed in both Java and C
